sources.name: XIAS
sources.reuse: Study actual hash-bound receipts, negative fixtures, keyboard and overflow scripts; use native browser/axe test packages
sources.caveat: 52 checks exist in source but were not executed in SMAT products; the gate does not certify subjective design

sources.name: Jakub Krehel UI skills
sources.reuse: Separate diff review, state inventory, component stress cases, copy, typography, and redesign variants
sources.caveat: LLM skill instructions are not deterministic compliance or human usability proof

sources.name: Figma Console MCP
sources.reuse: Adopt adapter shape for token export, design/code parity and auditable human changes
sources.caveat: Requires Figma client pairing; no live write test, plan or seat verified

sources.name: Figma Skills
sources.reuse: Study Plugin API variable and alias handling with current official Figma MCP
sources.caveat: Requires official use_figma write access; no connected user Figma file inspected

sources.name: Design Systems MCP
sources.reuse: Query cited standards and enterprise design-system patterns instead of hallucinating specs
sources.caveat: Curated source may lag; verify W3C/Apple/WCAG primary docs and runtime availability

sources.name: Playwright CLI Skills
sources.reuse: Use the official CLI + skills for repeatable browser user-task steps and screenshots
sources.caveat: No local installation done; protect production mutations and credentials

sources.name: Playwright MCP
sources.reuse: Use for interactive accessibility-tree DOM exploration in an MCP host
sources.caveat: Browser automation alone cannot prove visual quality or user value

sources.name: axe-core
sources.reuse: Use supported axe-core package rather than custom WCAG rule parser
sources.caveat: Automated checks cover a subset of WCAG; manual review remains essential

sources.name: Storybook addon MCP
sources.reuse: Use official @storybook/addon-mcp to query documented stories, component props and state tests
sources.caveat: Addon runtime or presence in target repo not verified; do not use archived storybookjs/mcp fork

sources.name: shadcn/ui
sources.reuse: Reuse components via official CLI/registry, preserve app existing dependencies and semantics
sources.caveat: Not an independent design QA gate, adapting copied code needs review

sources.name: 21st MCP / legacy magic compatibility
sources.reuse: Use catalog search/get_component behind user-entitled 21st MCP, not raw generated UI
sources.caveat: Legacy Magic proxy, hosted credentials and commercial rights must be verified

sources.name: Mobbin Skills
sources.reuse: Reference real app screenshots and flows via authorized Mobbin MCP
sources.caveat: Paid account; copyrighted screenshot use is inspiration-only, not copying or dataset construction

sources.name: Google Stitch Skills
sources.reuse: Generate competing directions and compare with user task constraints
sources.caveat: Stitch model outputs unverified; requires separate service connection

sources.name: Impeccable
sources.reuse: Study PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md context plus critique/redo stages
sources.caveat: Do not adopt optional live Apply fallback that disables agent permission or sandbox checks

sources.name: UX/UI Principles
sources.reuse: Study categories and UX smell reporting, not copy verbatim
sources.caveat: Enriched 195 principles depend on paid API; no compatible source-port license verified

sources.name: Penpot
sources.reuse: Optional Figma alternative via official main repo MCP module
sources.caveat: Old penpot/penpot-mcp repo is archived; mainline MCP API/current setup must be checked

sources.name: Argos
sources.reuse: Optional managed screenshot-baseline comparison in CI
sources.caveat: Requires baseline ownership, environment parity, and service credentials
